# The DSA Woodshed

> Company-neutral Python practice, tested reference implementations, study
> material, and reproducible print inputs.

- [Practice contract](TRACK-CONTRACT.md): observable commands, states, candidate
  ownership, and study snapshots.
- [Getting started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): first-session walkthrough.
- [Source of truth](docs/guide/source-of-truth.md): authored inputs, generated
  artifacts, production site, and private downstream boundary.
- [Command map](agent-map.md): public interfaces for humans and optional tools.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): signed fork-first contribution workflow.

Start with `just session` to choose an activity and time. Direct editor practice
uses `just practice-start comments`, followed by `just practice-next`, focused
tests, and `just practice-finish "one fix"`. `just practice-study topic problem`
opens immutable reference snapshots without creating a rep.

Python is the implemented practice track. Cross-language notes are study
context. Personal agent personas, skills, prompts, and provider settings belong
on contribution-fork overlays.

[dsa-woodshed.space](https://dsa-woodshed.space) is the production reading site.
It consumes one packet revision and verifies source digests before build.
Reference source, tests, and authored sheets are durable inputs. Candidate
work, personal logs, credentials, and employer-specific prep stay private.
